top_signals.title: Dollar Heads for Worst Week in Over a Month as Warsh Stays Quiet
top_signals.summary: The dollar is about to break a four-week winning streak after remarks from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh failed to give it a lift.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: S&P 500 Slides as Chipmakers Extend Slump on Growing AI Worries
top_signals.summary: The S&P 500 Index drifted lower on Friday and was on track for its worst week in about two months as worries about the viability of the artificial intelligence trade weighed on chipmakers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Order to limit Starshield for Ukraine came from inside White House, sources say
top_signals.summary: The order to limit a satellite system used by Ukraine for battlefield communications and drone operations came from inside the White House.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CONNECT recap: Liquidity is tokenization’s next challenge, everyday stablecoins
top_signals.summary: Panelists at Cointelegraph’s Singapore CONNECT event explored opportunities in tokenized markets, the future of everyday stablecoin payments and the evolving landscape for crypto investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Long-Term Treasuries Fall as Dealer Survey Offers Little Signal
top_signals.summary: Long-term Treasuries fell after some Wall Street predictions fell flat that US government officials would directly nod at the possibility of reducing its sales of those securities.
